title: What Is Hyperbole? — Educational Rap for Language Arts Students
skills: identify hyperbole in literary and everyday language
analyze how exaggeration creates emphasis, humor, or emotional effect
apply hyperbole intentionally in creative and rhetorical writing
alignment_note: Introduces hyperbole as intentional exaggeration used for emphasis, humor, imagery, or emotional effect. Supports figurative-language analysis, interpretation of author's craft, rhetorical awareness, and creative writing across high school English courses.
